page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Printed page number 485 at top right, running head "IN PIND. NEMEA." at top centre. Below the text: the closing words FINIS NEMEORUM, then the title block IN ISTHMIA PINDARI ΥΠΟΜΝΗΜΑΤΑ with a new text section below it, which begins with a decorative initial. No marginal notes. Gathering signature "Pp.iij" at bottom right, under the last line.

main_text.p: mum tuum frustra curis maceres. Verùm per se elegans gnome est, & digna observatione sententia: simile est Latinorum, Nitimur in vetitum, cupimusque negata. Rei amor prohibitæ, aut illicitæ, vel naturâ impossibilis, multò vehementior est, quàm is amor, qui licitus & concessus est, ut re cupita potiri possit. Furoris fit, quod licet ingratum est, ut ait ille: quod non licet acrius urit. Rectè ergo nominat ὀξυτέρας[?] μανίας, vehementiores insanias. furores amorum [illegible, ~9 letters] quos consequi nescias, quàm eorum quos assequi possis.
main_text.head: IN ISTHMIA PINDARI ΥΠΟΜΝΗΜΑΤΑ.
main_text.p: INTER periodica certamina ultimum locum tenent Isthmiaci ludi, de his paucis agemus, antequam ad hymnos Pindari perueniamus: ac pro more nostro explicanda erunt ista, à quo instituti hi ludi: in cuius gratiam: quando celebrati: quis honos victori habitus: ac si quid in his memoratu dignum acciderit, de quibus ἐξ[?] βραχέων[?] agemus, si prius de voce & eius origine admonuerimus.
main_text.head: Isthmus unde & quæ eius significatio.
main_text.p: Ἰσθμὸς ut placet Grammaticis proprie collum significat, sic dictus ὅτι δὲ ἐντὸς τὰ σπλάγχνα[?]: significauit igitur τραχήλου[?] aliquando, vel eam partem quæ est μεταξὺ τῆς στόματος καὶ τῆς στομάχου[?], hoc est, inter os & gulam: sic enim Galenus in aphorismum 26. libri tertij describit. Hinc Ἴσθμον ornatus εὐτραχήλος[?] dicitur apud Homerum lib. Σ. Odyss.
vbi Eustathius interpres ait, ornatum colli esse, à parte corporis ita dictum, monile. Hinc etiam πυξίδημα[?] apud Hippocratem & Galenum confillæ, quia collo annexæ sunt aphorismo 26. lib. 3.
Ab hruius[?] similitudine dicitur Isthmus poculum apud.

page.notes: Printing: "Pp.iij" at bottom right is the gathering signature. Greek words marked [?] are only partly legible on the scan. The two Greek verse lines of the Homer quotation are not legible letter by letter and are marked illegible. "hruius" may be a printing error for "huius"; left as printed and marked. The title Greek ΥΠΟΜΝΗΜΑΤΑ is read from a faint scan. Long s has been normalised to s, and u/v to the vowel or consonant form. Several Latin words in the scan are blurred near the margin, so their spelling is taken from context and marked where unsure.
